patch_list: Hides the FOMO+ upsell cards and banners.
Removes the gray band between two posts in the feed.
Colors the dark theme with your wallpaper colors: tinted background, cards and borders, and the accent for links, buttons and labels.
Keeps the dark mode background black, with slightly lighter black cards, instead of tinting it with the wallpaper. Includes Material You.
Adds the themed app icon of Android 13 and later, which follows the wallpaper colors.
